# Gelabber v0.5.1

Hotfix for the Linux desktop app, reviewed in #176.

## Desktop app

- A wrong or unreachable server address no longer locks the app. Before, a
  mistyped address on the first screen was saved and opened on every start,
  leaving only an error page; reinstalling did not help because the address
  lives in `~/.config/io.github.till-und-scholler-ai-slop.gelabber/desktop.json`.
- New window menu **Gelabber → Server wechseln …** opens the server screen
  from any page, including error pages, with the current server filled in
  and a button back to it. **Neu laden** reloads the page.
- The server screen saves an address only once something answers there and
  shows the reason otherwise.
- Arch: `yay -Syu` brings the update. Signing key fingerprint:
  `5992A8FD7578E86E36D45A4001C81EE2C2C0BBC5`.

## Upgrade and operation

- Server side unchanged since v0.5.0: no migrations, no `.env` changes. The
  image set (`GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE`) moves to `v0.5.1` together;
  rolling back to v0.5.0 or v0.4.0 touches no data.

## Open

- Acceptance of the desktop app on real NVIDIA and Intel hardware and the
  H264 licensing question remain as listed in v0.5.0.
